verdict.rationale: Jules is a task-executing coding agent that creates its own PRs. Nothing in the evidence documents it automatically reviewing every incoming pull request or posting AI-generated inline review comments. The only related item is the API, which says developers can 'automate tasks like... code reviews'. That is a building block for constructing such a workflow, not a shipped automatic PR-review capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can have every pull request automatically reviewed with AI-generated inline comments

citations.quote: You can use the API to create custom workflows, automate tasks like bug fixing and code reviews
